description: The Hodge on/off H-alpha narrow-band filters (6563, 6585, 6607, 6629), listed in the Apache Point Observatory filter inventory as not on site but available on loan from Paul Hodge (University of Washington).
facility_description: The ARC 3.5-meter Telescope is an optical/infrared telescope at Apache Point Observatory (APO) in New Mexico, operated by the Astrophysical Research Consortium.
notes: Centres and FWHMs are from the APO Hodge page, which gives a high-resolution trace near peak and a 300-1200 nm trace for each filter.

6563nm.Description: Hodge 6563 H-alpha narrow-band filter (APO lists centre 656.2 nm, FWHM 2.3 nm)

6585nm.Description: Hodge 6585 H-alpha narrow-band filter (APO lists centre 658.6 nm, FWHM 2.23 nm)

6607nm.Description: Hodge 6607 H-alpha narrow-band filter (APO lists centre 660.8 nm, FWHM 2.42 nm)

6629nm.Description: Hodge 6629 H-alpha narrow-band filter (APO lists centre 662.8 nm, FWHM 2.63 nm)
